name: Arrow Glyphs for Vector Field Visualization
definition: A visualization technique using arrow-shaped glyphs to resolve direction ambiguity. Each glyph consists of 9 vertices and 6 faces (triangles), computed entirely on the GPU to avoid CPU-GPU transfer.
summary: Arrow glyphs use arrow-shaped primitives to resolve direction ambiguity in vector fields, offering clear 3D cues and GPU-accelerated performance superior to line glyphs.
